items.headline: Week 3 NFL highlights: Best plays, moments, touchdowns, more
items.description: Sunday of Week 3 has seen 13 games played, with Lamar Jackson, Jahmyr Gibbs and Sam Darnold having big stat days.

items.headline: Bears QB Bagent clears protocol; Keenum likely to start vs. Eagles
items.description: The Bears' Tyson Bagent has cleared the concussion protocol, but Case Keenum is expected to start Monday night's game at quarterback against the Eagles.

items.headline: Caleb Williams is dealing with a Grade 2 hamstring strain
items.description: Ian Rapoport provides an update on Bears QB Caleb Williams' hamstring injury and how much time he could miss.

items.headline: Schefter: Bears expect Caleb Williams to miss multiple weeks

items.headline: Sources: Caleb Williams injury considered to have 3-4 week timeline
items.description: Bears quarterback Caleb Williams has a Grade 2 hamstring injury that doctors say could sideline him for three to four weeks, league sources told ESPN and NFL Network.

items.headline: Bears QB Williams out for MNF; backup Bagent back at practice
items.description: Bears QB Caleb Williams is out for Monday's game against the Eagles, and backup Tyson Bagent returned to the practice field while still in the concussion protocol.
